player_0.content: New plan: I failed to explore the full map because I entered the Cellar and immediately stopped, assuming no new rooms were reachable without checking the available directions. I should have recognized that "south" was an untried direction and moved there to continue exploring. Next time, I will systematically check every available direction in the current room before deciding to stop, ensuring I only issue "DONE" when all reachable directions have been visited.
